description:
Execute a token swap on Bitflow DEX.

Swaps tokenX for tokenY using Bitflow's aggregated liquidity.
Automatically finds the best route across all Bitflow pools.
No API key required — uses public endpoints (500 req/min).
Requires an unlocked wallet with sufficient token balance.

Note: Bitflow is only available on mainnet.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

amountIn.description: Amount of input token. Default interpretation is human units (e.g. '100' = 100 LEO).

amountUnit.description: Required. Amount units: 'human' (frontend-style decimal, e.g. '2' for 2 STX) or 'base' (smallest integer units, e.g. '2000000' for 2 STX).

confirmHighImpact.description: Set true to execute swaps with price impact above 5%

fee.description: Optional fee: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' preset or micro-STX amount. If omitted, auto-estimated.

name: bitflow_swap
